findings.title: LCG overflows double precision in random round-trip test
findings.why: `seed * 1103515245` can reach about 2.4e18, which is above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. The low bits are rounded away, so the generator isn't the intended LCG and its output is poorer than it looks. The test is still deterministic, so it only weakens coverage. BigInt or Math.imul-based arithmetic would fix it.
